data.title: Everyday Reactions
data.description: Explore how the building blocks of matter rearrange in amazing transformations all around you.

equations.realWorld: This reaction happens inside hydrogen fuel cell cars to generate clean electricity and pure water.
This reaction is used in factories to produce the edible seasoning we sprinkle on our food every day.
This slow chemical change creates reddish-brown flaky coatings on old bicycles left outside in the rain.
